warnings.description: enrich_entry still pre-truncates bodies with truncate_body(&first.body, 10, 500) before token-budget logic runs. --max-tokens can never include more than the fixed 500-char/10-line snippet even when the budget allows it.
warnings.suggestion: Move fixed snippet truncation out of enrich_entry for the context path, or make enrich_entry provide the raw cleaned body to the budget-aware truncation step.

warnings.description: context_pack_max_tokens_limits_output only asserts when full_tokens > 10 && full_included > 1. Test can silently stop validating.
warnings.suggestion: Make the fixture deterministically large enough to trigger limiting, or fail explicitly.

warnings.description: context_pack_max_tokens_snippet_truncation gates assertions behind if has_snippet, so it can pass without exercising truncation.
warnings.suggestion: Use a fixture that guarantees a snippet-bearing entry.

summary: 重大なパニック源、unsafe、パストラバーサルは見当たらない。主な懸念は固定500文字/10行の事前切り詰めが新しい--max-tokens制御の実効性を弱めている点。E2Eテストの一部が条件付きで実質ノーオペレーション化し得る。
note: medium warning は enrich_entry の事前truncate_bodyの制限。現時点では max_tokens 未指定時の出力制御として必要な既存動作であり、即座のcritical修正は不要。Phase 4のリファクタリングで検討する。
